messages:
Ana: late-night question — rewatching a film tonight, want an obsessive soundtrack to go with it. suggestions? thinking moody synth or dusty guitar 
Mike: Sorcerer + Tangerine Dream if you want hypnotic tension. perfect for 2am vibes.
Devon: Paris, Texas + Ry Cooder for a sunburnt, lonely highway energy.
Rachel: tiny poll: 1) Blade Runner + Vangelis 2) Paris, Texas + Ry Cooder 3) Sorcerer + Tangerine Dream 4) Wildcard — reply with recs 
Ana: voting 4 — wildcard rec: The Long Good Friday + John Barry, surprisingly grim and elegant
Mike: also consider Stalker + Eduard Artemyev for a slow-burn, unsettling ambient listen
Devon: if anyone likes behind-the-scenes, Song Exploder eps pair weirdly well with soundtrack deep-dives
OpsBot: reminder: vinyl club meets Thu 6pm by the kitchen — bring recs! :vinyl: :coffee:
Rachel: I'll make a shared playlist from recs after lunch. drop Spotify/YT links or short notes here
Ana: starting with one: https://youtu.be/example-sorcerer-track — that pulsing arpeggio is the mood machine
Mike: :thumbsup: adding. also low-key plug: If you want film noir + synth, try 'Manhunter' OST
Devon: thanks everyone, building my weekend queue. Lina fyi — thought you'd like this thread @Lina
Lina: nice, love these swaps. adding The Last Wave + Peter Sculthorpe and a weird rec: 'Koyaanisqatsi' + Philip Glass
Rachel: excellent — playlist is getting very cinematic. will ping when it's live
Ana: thanks all — definite cozy, slightly haunted viewing ahead :popcorn:
